steps: Open a fresh normal local URL, verify index-DXgUfY_A.js, click Play, and select the actual Uppal area button. Wait for the loading screen to clear.
Observe the car on a straight residential street, then accept Pista House. Ground HUD shows 901 m and 2.5 s flight boost.

Tap Space once and hold W for 0.4 s. The car visibly lifts above the neighboring roofs. HUD reads Flying · follow the destination beacon, approximately 325 m, 1.9 s boost and 16 km/h. Save the original flying screenshot.

Tap Space again immediately, while boost remains. The next screenshot shows the car lower in the view with continued Flying · follow the destination beacon wording, approximately 326 m, 1.8 s boost and 12 km/h. The 3D ground ribbon is absent in both aerial screenshots. Save the original descent screenshot.

Without further driving input, let the car settle. It is visibly back on the street at 0 km/h. The Flying/beacon note disappears, the road-route distance is 897 m, and the 3D road ribbon is visible again. Boost remains 1.8 s. Save the original landed screenshot.
Open Pause with P, inspect captured warning/error logs, save the three originals through the local evidence form, then close the test tab and all temporary helper tabs. Release the shared input lock.
